title: Substitution of admissible words in structural coefficient squares
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, a coefficient datum $C$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_{C.\ell}$, and the independently fixed operation models $o$ [def-sf-generator-reduction-data]. Fix universe levels $s,i$. For every finite-type $D.k$-scheme family $W:S\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ with $S:\mathrm{Type}_s$, input locations $\lambda:I\to S$ with $I:\mathrm{Type}_i$, let $B_{\mathrm{int}}$, $B(\mathcal R K)$, $r_B$ and the canonical integral and system generator maps be the word evaluations and comparisons of [def-sf-generator-reduction-data]. Use the predicate Structural and its family StructuralSquares of [lem-sf-open-interchange-reduction-squares]: exactly tensor associativity, two scalar unitors, pullback and proper direct-image composition, and the units and counits of proper pullback/direct image and of quasi-compact open extension/restriction. Assume the coefficient square Assertion for each of these generators whenever both endpoint words have length at most three, for every such family and input family satisfying Admissible and both endpoint Word.admissible with common cohomological and Tor intervals. Then the same structural coefficient squares hold for every finite pair of endpoint words, with the same input and endpoint admissibility hypotheses, without a length bound. No open base-change, open-tensor, proper/open interchange or proper/open restriction square is asserted. No preservation of admissibility for unrelated words is assumed.

lean.statement:
theorem structuralReductionWordSubstitution
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} (coeff : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic coeff.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic coeff.l) E] (o : GeneratorReduction.Operations coeff.l E)
    (hShort : ∀ {S : Type s} (W : S → Scheme.{u})
      (_hW : GeneratorReduction.FiniteTypeFamily W D.k)
      {I : Type i} (location : I → S)
      {a : S} {B C : GeneratorReduction.Word W location a}
      (g : GeneratorReduction.GeneratorKind W location B C),
      Structural g → B.length ≤ 3 → C.length ≤ 3 →
      ∀ (K : ∀ k : I, DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource coeff.l E (W (location k))))
        (lo hi torLo torHi : ℤ),
        (∀ k : I, GeneratorReduction.Admissible coeff.l E
          (IntegralSystemRealization.calculus coeff.l E (W (location k))) (K k)
          lo hi torLo torHi) →
        B.admissible coeff.l E W location o K lo hi torLo torHi →
        C.admissible coeff.l E W location o K lo hi torLo torHi →
        GeneratorReduction.Assertion coeff.l E W location o K g) :
    StructuralSquares.{u, s, i} coeff.l E D o
